rounds.q: What % of US adults usually get less than 7 hours of sleep?
rounds.why: It ranges by county from 24% in Boulder, Colorado to 48% in Greene County, Alabama.
rounds.src: CDC, Preventing Chronic Disease, short sleep by county (2020 data)
rounds.fun: One in three of us is running low on sleep. Time for an early night!

rounds.q: What % of US high schoolers get 8+ hours of sleep on school nights?
rounds.why: 9th graders do best at 31%, while only 20% of 12th graders get that much.
rounds.src: CDC, Youth Risk Behavior Survey (2025 data)
rounds.fun: Only about 1 in 4 teens sleeps 8 hours on a school night. Let them snooze!

rounds.q: How many hours a day do wild sloths sleep?
rounds.why: The exact figure is 9.6 hours, over 6 hours less than sloths measured in captivity.
rounds.src: Rattenborg et al., Biology Letters, sleep in wild sloths (2008 study)
rounds.fun: Wild sloths sleep only about 10 hours a day. Busier than they look!

rounds.q: What % of people sleepwalk at least once in their life?
rounds.why: The exact figure is 6.9%, and in a given year 5% of kids sleepwalk but only 1.5% of adults.
rounds.src: Stallman and Kohler, PLOS ONE meta-analysis of 51 studies (2016)
rounds.fun: About 7 in 100 of us have gone for a stroll while fast asleep!

rounds.q: What % of people have ever known they were dreaming during a dream?
rounds.why: About 23% of people have a dream like that at least once a month.
rounds.src: Saunders et al., Consciousness and Cognition meta-analysis of 34 studies (2016)
rounds.fun: More than half of us have caught ourselves mid-dream. Sweet dreams!
